text: Charitable giving has to be fully transparent and hosted by a group of charity experts who have hands on experience fostering common good outcomes directly, rather than acting as an intermediary or sponsor.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021

isBasedOn.name: How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving

abstract: The basic concept of the CHARITYxDAO derives from the basic insight that charitable giving has to be fully transparent and hosted by a group of charity experts who have hands-on experience in fostering common good outcomes directly – not as an intermediary or sponsor.
